steps.en: Outstanding driver notices at the 3rd letter stage are collected for the day's batch
steps.id: Notice driver yang masih outstanding di tahap surat ke-3 dikumpulkan untuk batch hari itu

steps.en: Each individual driver is identified once among the notices in the batch
steps.id: Tiap driver individu dikenali satu kali di antara notice dalam batch
steps.why_en: The same driver with different due dates is treated as separate recipients and may get several messages.
steps.why_id: Driver yang sama dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda dianggap penerima terpisah dan bisa dapat beberapa pesan.

steps.en: Only individual drivers get the SMS; opted-out people, passports and companies are skipped
steps.id: Hanya driver individu yang dapat SMS; yang opt-out, paspor, dan company dilewati

steps.en: The SMS lists the driver's outstanding notices merged into one message
steps.id: SMS memuat daftar notice outstanding driver yang digabung jadi satu pesan

steps.en: The SMS refers to the 3rd letter that was sent
steps.id: SMS merujuk ke surat ke-3 yang sudah dikirim
steps.why_en: Nothing in the system inserts the letter reference; it depends only on the message wording stored in the database.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menyisipkan referensi surat; hanya bergantung pada kata-kata pesan yang tersimpan di database.

steps.en: The SMS reminder is sent out as a batch of messages
steps.id: SMS reminder dikirim sebagai batch pesan
steps.why_en: The sending code exists, but in production the daily job and SMS sending are switched off by configuration.
steps.why_id: Code pengiriman ada, tapi di produksi job harian dan pengiriman SMS dimatikan lewat konfigurasi.
